about: [C2] The test bed's teach (src/scenes/91_guns.js, beat ready) by real input: the desk over (E at its prompt), the teach card [C] get low and C, the card [RMB] rise and aim and RMB held (up over the desk), the bottles on the cabinet by the door shot, the card [R] reload and R down behind it, on to the door beat; each card shown once. node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/guns_teach.json

steps.name: the title, BEGIN at the test bed
[RMB] rise and aim; onto the bottles on the cabinet

steps.look: (() => { const b = G.stage.part('house').teachBottles.find(q => !q.h.broken); const p = new N.THREE.Vector3(); b.obj.getWorldPosition(p); p.y += 0.12; const e = G.eye, C = N.controller; const yw = Math.atan2(-(p.x - e.x), -(p.z - e.z)), pt = Math.atan2(p.y - e.y, Math.hypot(p.x - e.x, p.z - e.z)); const dy = Math.atan2(Math.sin(yw - C.yaw), Math.cos(yw - C.yaw)); return [Math.round(-dy / C.sensitivity), Math.round(-(pt - C.pitch) / C.sensitivity)]; })()

(() => { const b = G.stage.part('house').teachBottles.find(q => !q.h.broken); if (!b) return [0, 0]; const p = new N.THREE.Vector3(); b.obj.getWorldPosition(p); p.y += 0.12; const e = G.eye, C = N.controller; const yw = Math.atan2(-(p.x - e.x), -(p.z - e.z)), pt = Math.atan2(p.y - e.y, Math.hypot(p.x - e.x, p.z - e.z)); const dy = Math.atan2(Math.sin(yw - C.yaw), Math.cos(yw - C.yaw)); return [Math.round(-dy / C.sensitivity), Math.round(-(pt - C.pitch) / C.sensitivity)]; })()
